config_findings.message: Confirmed session paths remain enabled. Vendor temporary advice disables upload progress before parsing and restarts ALL workers; this is not a complete fix.
Review memory and request-size controls with the official advisory. memory_limit=-1 is not a complete fix and can increase availability risk; no automatic changes are made.
